grammar.summary: 本课学习表「何种程度」的 to what extent 与 self-defense 语义。

points.title: to what extent 表何种程度
points.explanation: To what extent is the venom defensive? 宾语从句里的疑问引导：to what/that extent 程度补语。

examples.en: It is hard to tell to what extent snakes use venom for defense.
examples.cn: 很难说蛇在多大程度上用毒液自卫。

points.title: 表「因应」的 in response to
points.explanation: Venom evolved in response to prey. = 作为对……的回应。生物类说明文因果标配。

examples.en: They use venom in response to threats.
